data.name: Farida
data.gender_notes: Farida is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ف-ر-د (f-r-d), 'to be unique'. Farīda means 'unique, precious'. Its root is ف-ر-د (f-r-d). A common Muslim female name. Farida is a Arabic name meaning “Unique; precious; a pearl”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Farida expresses “Unique; precious; a pearl”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ف-ر-د (f-r-d), 'to be unique'. Farīda means 'unique, precious'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farida total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
